# Longmeadow Family Dental Care

> > A family-focused dental practice in the tri-state area offering comprehensive general, cosmetic, preventive, and restorative dental services with hospital-grade air purification and a team of experienced dentists.

Longmeadow Family Dental Care serves families in the Washington County and tri-state region with a team led by Dr. Brandon K. Ellis and other experienced dental professionals. The practice emphasizes patient safety through Surgically Clean Air technology, comprehensive patient education, and acceptance of major insurance providers.

## Key Topics

- Family Dentistry
- General Dentistry
- Preventive Care
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Restorative Dentistry
- Patient Safety
- Infection Control
- Surgically Clean Air
- New Patient Welcome
- Insurance Accepted

- HIPAA Compliance
- ADA Standards
